description: Reorder, delete, rotate and insert blank pages in one step by giving the FINAL page list. Each entry is `{"source": n, "rotate": 0|90|180|270}` (n is a page of the ORIGINAL document, 1-based) or `{"blank": true, "size": "previous"|"A4"|"Letter"}`. A page you leave out is deleted; the list order is the new order; a source page may appear only once; at least one entry must be a source page. Page numbers start at 1 (the check tools return 0-based `page` values: add 1). Writes a NEW .pdf inside the allowed folder and never changes or overwrites an existing file. Page labels are removed when pages are reordered or a blank is inserted; layers and static XFA are dropped (listed in `lost`); digital signatures are removed. `layout` in the result says where each output page came from. Example: {"pdfPath":"deck.pdf","pages":[{"source":2},{"source":1,"rotate":90},{"blank":true}],"outputPath":"deck-edited.pdf"}. This is not redaction and does not sanitise: pages you leave out are not copied, but document metadata, bookmark titles and anything a kept page shares with an omitted page can remain. Use redact_pdf to remove sensitive content. Nothing is uploaded.

outputPath.description: new .pdf to create; must not exist

rotate.description: clockwise turn added to the page's rotation

size.description: default previous: the size of the page before it (A4 if first)

pdfPath.description: path to the PDF, inside the allowed folder

name: edit_pages
